beats.care: If you run, cycle or have asthma, plan outdoor time for afternoons and keep a mask handy from Wednesday.
beats.what: CPCB put Delhi's 24-hour AQI at 139 on Monday, 'moderate'. Pusa was already 'poor' at 281.
beats.why: Winds are slow and nights are cooling, so smoke and dust stay trapped near the ground.

cards.body: IMD says it was 1.3°C below normal. Cooler, still nights help pollution stay close to the ground.
cards.caption: Monday's low at Safdarjung, coldest night of October so far

cards.body: Of 58 CPCB stations on Monday, 2 were 'poor' and 6 'satisfactory'; the rest were 'moderate'. Pusa was highest at 281.
cards.title: Where it's worst

cards.body: On Monday, farm-fire tracking found 98 fires across six states, but none in Haryana or Delhi.

cards.q: What does it mean if Delhi's AQI moves from 139 to 220?
cards.why: CPCB calls 101–200 'moderate' and 201–300 'poor', so 220 is a step worse.

cards.q: How do you deal with bad-air days?

cover.label: Delhi's air forecast to slip to 'poor'

hook: Why could Delhi's air *turn 'poor' by Wednesday*?

learn.t: Delhi's GRAP Stage 1 anti-pollution rules are meant to kick in when the AQI enters the 'poor' band, 201 to 300.

tldr: Delhi's air was 'moderate' on Monday, but the official forecast says it will turn 'poor' from Wednesday, October 21.
watch: The air forecast shows 'poor' air on October 21 and 22. Watch if CAQM brings in GRAP Stage 1.
